name: MF3-01 reach resolution is owner-bounded
expression: assert.deepEqual(reach, [{ scope: 'global', ownerId: null }, { scope: 'workspace', ownerId: null }]);
clause: Valid reachability uses the permitted Scope/owner pairs.
whyDirect: The production reach resolver is called with a Workspace-only context and its exact valid global/workspace pairs are asserted.
